title: Pick a cloud backup service
ask: After the laptop scare last month I want the shop's files backed up off site. Three services are in sources/options.md. Please brief me on which to use.
background: We have about 300 GB of photos and documents across two computers.
I need to be able to get back a file I deleted a couple of months ago.
Our IT helper, Bao, will set up whatever we choose.

constraints.text: list your reasons as bullets, three at most
put your pick under a heading called "Recommendation"
none of the sales words "best-in-class", "game-changer" or "no-brainer"
work only from the snapshot, no web lookups
name the file you worked from, sources/options.md
name Bao as the person who will set it up

start.sources/options.md:
# Cloud backup

Snapshot taken 1 March 2026. All prices in Australian dollars.

| Option | Price | Notes |
